name: Effective Range / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension (affine)
details: Every finite binary class satisfies $\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)\geq2\,\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)-1$, equivalently $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)\leq\lceil\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)/2\rceil$.
witness_verification: For #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
proof: After removing inactive coordinates, view $\mathcal H$ as a subfamily of the full cube on $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$ coordinates. No-clashing teaching dimension is monotonic under subfamilies, while Theorem 19 of Kirkpatrick--Simon--Zilles gives $\mathrm{NCTD}(2^{[m]})=\lceil m/2\rceil$. Thus $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)\leq\lceil\mathrm E(\mathcal H)/2\rceil$, which is equivalent to the stated affine inequality.
proof_source: Proposition prop:effective-range-low-nctd in the LaTeX survey.
